comparisons_are: descriptive paired differences; no significance or perceptual claims
denominator_policy: all expected episodes remain in status-pair counts; numerical differences use only pairs with two explicit submissions; no imputation for errors or truncation; equal-eight-cell mean requires every expected pair to submit
distribution_policy: NumPy arithmetic mean, median, percentile(90) with linear interpolation
sign_convention: actor minus comparator; negative means lower submitted distance
